newsitem.title: CHINA: Beijing bombings not linked to Xinjiang - official.
newsitem.headline: Beijing bombings not linked to Xinjiang - official.

text.p: Beijing Mayor Jia Qinglin said on Monday there was no evidence to link bombings in the Chinese capital last week with earlier attacks in the restive region of Xinjiang.
"So far we have uncovered no connection," Jia told reporters when asked if the bomb attacks in Beijing and Xinjiang were connected.
Authorities have strengthened security in Beijing, the mayor said.
"With the support of our police and the masses, we definitely have confidence," Jia said when asked if authorities believed they were near solving the case.

A bomb went off on a bus in Beijing's western Xidan district during the evening rush hour on Friday. China's state-controlled media have said no one died but sources said the blast killed at least two people and injured 30.
Three bus bombings rocked Xinjiang's regional capital of Urumqi on February 25, killing nine people and injuring 74.
